# Travel + Leisure Co. Expands Eddie Bauer Adventure Club with New Trail Partner Network


Oct 2, 2026 2:12pm EDT


*Under Canvas announced as first Trail Partner, giving owners access to all 18 Under Canvas properties using their Eddie Bauer Adventure Club credits*


ORLANDO, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Travel + Leisure Co.](https://www.travelandleisureco.com/us/en/news-events) (NYSE: TNL), a leading leisure travel company, today announced the introduction of Trail Partners, a new network of outdoor hospitality partners that gives Eddie Bauer Adventure Club owners more places to stay and explore using their club credits. Through the Trail Partner network, owners can use their credits to book stays and excursion add-ons with a growing selection of outdoor hospitality partners.[Under Canvas](https://www.undercanvas.com/) is the first Trail Partner announced as part of the network, giving owners access to all 18 Under Canvas properties across North America.


This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:[https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261002339286/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261002339286/en/)


Under Canvas Yosemite, one of 18 Under Canvas properties now available to Eddie Bauer Adventure Club owners through the club's new Trail Partner network. (Photo: Under Canvas)


A modern vacation club built on more than a century of Eddie Bauer’s outdoor heritage, the Eddie Bauer Adventure Club connects travelers with outdoor destinations and experiences, with its first Basecamp location which opened in Moab, Utah earlier this year. Basecamps serve as the anchor of the club’s dedicated properties, offering a comfortable home base in inspiring outdoor destinations.


“Eddie Bauer Adventure Club is designed to give people more ways to get outside and experience the places that inspire them,” said Sarah Koves, SVP, Brand Strategy at Travel + Leisure Co. “Our Basecamps give owners a signature Eddie Bauer Adventure Club experience in some of the world’s most compelling outdoor destinations, while Trail Partners expand the possibilities even further. Together, they create an ecosystem that gives owners more choice today and more to look forward to as we continue to grow.”


**Meet the First Trail Partner: Under Canvas**


Known for safari-inspired accommodations in some of the country’s most spectacular outdoor destinations, Under Canvas pairs immersive stays in nature with modern comforts. Its custom-designed canvas tents feature amenities such as king-size beds, contemporary furnishings, ensuite bathrooms and wood-burning stoves.


Through the Eddie Bauer Adventure Club, owners can stay at Under Canvas properties near some of the country’s most celebrated national parks and landscapes, including Yellowstone, Zion, the Grand Canyon, Yosemite, the Great Smoky Mountains, Santa Fe and the Columbia River Gorge in the Pacific Northwest.


**More Ways to Use Your Membership**


Eddie Bauer Adventure Club owners can access Trail Partner stays through the club's dedicated travel agency, which can help them explore participating destinations, check availability and use their credits toward eligible stays.


Beyond Basecamps and Trail Partner stays, Eddie Bauer Adventure Club owners have access to additional benefits, including 50% off regularly priced Eddie Bauer apparel and gear online, automatic Guide-Tier status in the Eddie Bauer Adventure Rewards Program, and one complimentary annual excursion for two people curated based on the season and setting.


Eddie Bauer Adventure Club is operated by Travel + Leisure Co. under a license from Authentic Brands Group.


For more information about Eddie Bauer Adventure Club, visit[eddiebaueradventureclub.com](https://www.eddiebaueradventureclub.com/) .


To learn more about Travel + Leisure Co. and its portfolio of leisure travel brands, please visit[travelandleisureco.com](https://www.travelandleisureco.com/) .


**About Travel + Leisure Co.**


Travel + Leisure Co. (NYSE: TNL) is a leading leisure travel company, providing more than six million vacations to travelers around the world every year. The company operates a diverse portfolio of vacation ownership, travel club, and lifestyle travel brands designed to meet the needs of the modern leisure traveler, whether they’re traversing the globe or enjoying destinations closer to home. This includes experiential brands such as Sports Illustrated Resorts, Eddie Bauer Adventure Club, Margaritaville Vacation Club, and Accor Vacation Club, as well as cornerstone brands, Club Wyndham, WorldMark, and RCI. With hospitality and responsible tourism at its heart, the company’s more than 19,000 dedicated associates worldwide help fulfill its mission to put the world on vacation. Learn more at[travelandleisureco.com](https://www.travelandleisureco.com/) .


**About Eddie Bauer**


For more than 100 years, outdoor brand Eddie Bauer has been inspiring, enabling, and empowering people to live their adventure with products that are built to last. Their performance outerwear, apparel, accessories and gear are available at[eddiebauer.com](http://eddiebauer.com/) .


Follow Eddie Bauer on[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/eddiebauer/) ,[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/EddieBauer/) and[X](https://twitter.com/eddiebauer/) .


**About Under Canvas**


The leader in upscale, outdoor hospitality, Under Canvas is the ultimate immersive experience. Its safari-style accommodations perfectly embrace their natural surroundings while featuring indoor luxuries, allowing guests to discover their outdoor self in comfort and style. Under Canvas operates 18 properties across three brands. To grant further access to the nation’s most coveted landscapes, Under Canvas expanded its portfolio with two additional brands. ULUM, a bespoke, MICHELIN Key, luxury outdoor resort brand that debuted its first location in Moab, Utah in spring of 2023. The Under Canvas Outdoor Collection is a line of distinctive, nature-based properties curated with place and purpose in mind. The Fields of Michigan in South Haven, MI, and Bar N Ranch in West Yellowstone, MT, make up the collection. There are 15 Under Canvas camps nationwide: Acadia (ME); Bar N Ranch (MT); Bryce Canyon (UT); Columbia River Gorge (WA); Glacier (MT); Grand Canyon (AZ); Great Smoky Mountains (TN); Lake Powell – Grand Staircase (UT); Moab (UT); Mount Rushmore (SD); North Yellowstone – Paradise Valley (MT); West Yellowstone (MT); White Mountains (NH); Yosemite (CA) and Santa Fe (NM) coming in 2027. For more information, please visit[http://www.undercanvas.com](http://www.undercanvas.com/) and[http://www.ulumresorts.com.](http://www.ulumresorts.com./)
